alt: A grey traffic speed-enforcement camera mounted on a roadside pole, trees in the background
story: Slovakia installed 279 NERO R-ONE speed cameras using EU road-safety funds, then its national security service discovered they were rebranded Russian gear with SMS-triggered backdoor shell access and passwordless live video feeds.
why_funny: A government scheme to make roads safer accidentally handed Russia a ready-to-activate nationwide surveillance network—reachable by a text from a St Petersburg phone number.
